name: Aboleth, Psionic Veiled Master
body:
Aboleth, Psionic Veiled Master
CR 14

XP 38,400
LE Large aberration (aquatic, shapechanger, psionic)
Init +10; Senses darkvision 120 ft.; Perception +23

DEFENSE

AC 30, touch 15, flat-footed 24 (+6 Dex, +11 natural, +4 shield, –1 size)
hp 200 (16d8+128); fast healing 10
Fort +13, Ref +13, Will +14
Immune electricity, mind-affecting effects; Resist cold 20; PR 25

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft., swim 80 ft.
Melee bite +17 (2d6+6 plus consume memory and slime), 2 claws +17 (1d6+6 plus slime), 4 tentacles +12 touch (2d6+3 electricity plus thoughtlance)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft. (20 ft. with claws and tentacles)
Special Attacks delayed suggestion, mucus cloud
Psi-Like Abilities (ML 16th; concentration +26)

Constant–force screen
At will–compelling voice (DC 24, 8 targets), complex false sensory input * (DC 24), correspond (160 minutes), ego whip (4d4, DC 24), ensconce (DC 23), major metamorphosis *, memory modification (DC 20), mind probe (DC 24), moment of terror (DC 18, imposes penalty on saving throws regardless of success), mindlink *
3/day–mind control* (DC 24), quickened mind control* (DC 21), parasitic possession (DC 21, control target), psionic effigy*

Typical Cryptic Powers Known (ML 16th; power points: 128; base save DC 16 + power level; concentration +21)

Talents-detect psionics, far hand, psionic repair
1st-call to mind, kinetic legerdemain, vigor
2nd–animal affinity, cloud mind, control sound
3rd-dispel psionics, ectoplasmic grapnel, greater concealing amorpha
4th-fold space, hidden body, slip the bonds
5th-bonding strike, pierce the veils, retrieve
6th-cosmic awareness

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 22, Con 27, Int 21, Wis 19, Cha 22
Base Atk +12; CMB +19; CMD 35 (cannot be tripped)
Feats Combat Manifestation, Extend Power, Improved Initiative, Improved Metamorphosis, Lightning Reflexes, Master of All Forms, Metapsionic Ability (mind control, Quicken Power ), Psionic Meditation, Quicken Power, Scribe Tattoo, Swift Shapeshifter
Skills Knowledge (arcana) +21, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +21, Knowledge (history) +21, Knowledge (nature) +21, Perception +23, Sense Motive +20, Spellcraft +24, Stealth +21, Swim +33
Languages Aboleth, Aklo, Aquan, Undercommon, one more; telepathy 300 ft.
SQ tattoo mastery, transformation master

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Consume Memory (Su)

When a veiled master bites a creature, it consumes some of that creature’s memories.

The creature bitten must succeed at a DC 24 Fortitude save or gain one negative level. A veiled master heals 5 points of damage each time it grants a negative level in this way, and also learns some of the target creature’s memories (subject to the GM’s discretion). This is a mind-affecting effect. A veiled master can suppress this ability as a free action. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Delayed Suggestion (Psi)

Whenever a veiled master successfully uses mind control on a creature, it can also implant a delayed compelling voice effect that triggers when domination effect ends. Typically, this effect (which functions as a psi-like ability, ML 20th, Will DC 25 negates) is for the previously dominated creature to seek out the veiled master again and submit to a new domination attempt, but sometimes, a veiled master implants other suggestions (such as a suggestion to attack the first person it sees).

Mucus Cloud (Ex)

While underwater, a veiled master exudes a cloud of transparent slime in a 30-foot-radius spread. All creatures in this area must succeed at a DC 26 Fortitude save each round or lose the ability to breathe air (but gain the ability to breathe water) for 24 hours. Renewed contact with this mucus cloud and failing another save extends the effect for another 24 hours. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Slime (Ex)

A creature hit by any of a veiled master’s bite or claw attacks must succeed at a DC 26 Fortitude save or have its skin and flesh transform into a clear, slimy membrane over the course of 1d4 rounds. The creature’s new flesh is soft and tender, reducing its Constitution score by 4 as long as the condition persists. If the creature’s flesh is not kept moist, it dries quickly and the victim takes 1d12 points of damage every 10 minutes. Remove disease and similar effects can restore an afflicted creature to normal, but immunity to disease offers no protection from this attack. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Powers A veiled master can manifest psionic powers as a 16th-level cryptic.

Tattoo Mastery (Ex)

A veiled master is particularly skilled at creating and utilizing psionic tattoos. They gain Scribe Tattoo as a bonus feat, as well as the benefits of the Enhance Tattoo, Eternal Tattoo, and Extend Tattoo cryptic insights.

Thoughtlance (Su)

Four of a veiled master’s tentacles end in glowing spheres of light. These spheres deal 2d6 points of electricity damage on a touch attack, and also blast a creature’s mind with waves of mental energy–a creature touched by one of these tentacles (regardless of whether the touch deals electricity damage) must succeed at a DC 24 Will save or be staggered for 1 round. Additional touches increase the duration by 1 round. While a creature is staggered in this manner, it must attempt concentration checks to manifest powers as if it were experiencing extremely violent motion while manifesting (DC = 20 + power level). The save DC is Charisma-based.

Transformation Master (Su)

A veiled master gains Swift Shapeshifter and Master of All Forms as bonus feats. In addition, the duration of its major metamorphosis psi-like ability changes to permanent (D).

ECOLOGY

Environment any aquatic
Organization solitary, pair, brood (3–6), or shoal (7–19)
Treasure double

As befits their hideous primeval appearance, the hermaphroditic aboleths are among the world’s oldest forms of life. Ancient even when the gods first turned their eyes to the Material Plane, the aboleths have always existed apart from other mortal life, alien and cold and endlessly plotting. They once ruled the world with vast empires, and today view most other forms of life as either food or slaves—and sometimes both. They disdain the gods and see themselves as the true masters of creation. An aboleth is 25 feet long and weighs 6,500 pounds.

In the darkest reaches of the sea, aboleths still dwell in grotesque cities built in nauseating and cyclopean styles. There they are served by countless slaves culled from every nation, air-breathing and aquatic alike, although the air-breathing slaves are doubly bound by magic and the need to constantly replenish their water-breathing ability via the excretions of their aboleth masters. Lone aboleths are often advance scouts for these hidden cities, seeking out new slaves.
